name: @chatdom/surveyor
description: Atlas read/export/cartography service. Reads the running Surveyor read-only; writes only ATLAS_DATA_DIR.

scripts.atlas:import: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs import
scripts.atlas:check: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs check
scripts.atlas:serve: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs serve
scripts.atlas:found: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs found
scripts.atlas:settle: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs settle
scripts.atlas:rehearse: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs rehearse
scripts.atlas:authorize: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs authorize
scripts.atlas:live: vite build --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/atlas.mjs live
